get_class_from_dynamic_module: extract a class from a dynamically loaded module file downloaded from a huggingface hub repository
get_cached_module_file: download and cache a module file from a local folder or distant huggingface hub repository
custom_object_save: save modeling files corresponding to a custom model or tokenizer in a given folder with auto_map registration
check_imports: check if the current python environment contains all libraries imported in a module file
check_python_requirements: confirm the environment has all python dependencies installed from a requirements.txt file
